verdict.rationale: The evidence pack documents no user-facing control over data retention or deletion, such as a no-cache or no-store option, a deletion API, or a retention policy setting. The only related items are a fixed 5-minute cache (a retention fact, not a control) and the self-hosted option of caching fetched pages in an S3-compatible bucket. Both are adjacent caching behavior or self-hosting workarounds, not a retention or deletion capability.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can control data retention and deletion
